units.source_text: 可是名人抱怨溪流声太大，一连两晚无法成眠。

en.t: But the Master complained that the sound of the stream was too loud, and for two nights in a row he could not sleep.

units.source_text: 他要把棋盘搬到尽可能远离溪流的独间去。

en.t: He wanted to move the go board to a private room as far away from the stream as possible.

units.source_text: 被人劝说哪怕拍张照也成，名人才勉强坐了下来，

en.t: Only after being urged to sit even just for a photograph did the Master reluctantly take his seat,

units.source_text: 他对用这家旅馆做对局场地流露了不满。

en.t: and he showed his dissatisfaction with using this inn as the venue for the match.
